messages.author: e2ca5093917af03b
messages.subject: Re: why after error in shinyR i still have to click stop to be able to run the app again
parts:
Hi
thanks,
1) To use Escape you need to click on the console first, or use a keyboard complicated shortcut to get your focus there,  which is as uncomfortable as clicking on the "stop" sign.
2) The particular situation I am talking about, is sometimes, the App is already shutdown (the "browser" window is closed) but you still need to go to that "stop" sign and click on it. I think at these situations Escape ain't work. It is when you are using the breakpoints or browser() functionalities I think. You get into place you need to click on the "stop" button and then "stop" sign to actuall re-run app.

messages.author: a1bf76ab9a5a2d4b
messages.subject: Re: why after error in shinyR i still have to click stop to be able to run the app again
parts: Just because the browser window is closed doesn't necessarily mean the app should be killed.  You could open up a new browser window/tab and go to the app URL. Shiny is meant to be able to work as a server for multiple connections, so just because one errored out doesn't mean others can't still use it
